## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue when relevant.

## Validation

List the commands actually run and their results. Explain omitted relevant checks.
For reducer/oracle changes, cover failure identity, isolation and fresh restore.

## Compatibility

Describe any CLI, configuration, oracle, report or supported-version changes.
Write "None" if there are none.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and includes regression coverage where applicable.
- [ ] Documentation and the Unreleased changelog are updated when relevant.
- [ ] No credentials, private dumps or sensitive oracle output are included.
